signals_info.description: Whether the lane-keeping system is actively controlling the vehicle.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some future time, the condition lkas_active == 1 shall cease to be true.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在未来某个时刻，lkas_active == 1 这一条件应刚停止成立。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The lane-keeping system shall end active control at some future time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 车道保持系统应在未来某个时刻结束主动控制。
